name: effort-router
description: Reads the conversation before each prompt runs until the task is clear (a Haiku read against Anthropic's 'Spending your effort' guidance and your own rules). If its level matches your effort picker the turn just runs and that level is kept; if it differs, the turn waits on one question (Use high / Keep medium) and your answer is kept. /route asks on demand, optionally with a hint. Each subagent gets its own level from a read of its brief at spawn. The footer shows the state (deciding, high? while asking, high 🔒, off) and is a button that opens the router's band above the prompt.

consent.title: When the router wants a different level
consent.description: When the router wants a different level from your effort picker: "ask" (default) holds the turn and asks you (Use the router's level, or Keep yours); "auto" uses the router's level without asking and shows it above the prompt with Revert to picker. Either way the choice is kept for the session.

classifyTimeoutMs.title: Classifier timeout (ms)
classifyTimeoutMs.description: How long a prompt waits for the router's read before it runs anyway at the current level. The read usually takes 1-2 seconds.

classifierMaxChars.title: Classifier input cap (chars)
classifierMaxChars.description: Most transcript characters one read sends. The first prompt is always kept, then the newest lines, your prompts and answers before Claude's replies.

decideWithin.title: Decide within (prompts)
decideWithin.description: How many of your prompts (and answered questions) the router reads automatically. If nothing is locked by then it stops reading: a level in use is locked, a pending suggestion stays pending, otherwise the router turns off. /route asks again at any time.

classifierModel.title: Classifier model
classifierModel.description: Alias or id of the model that reads the transcript.

syncPicker.title: Sync the effort picker
syncPicker.description: Run /effort <level> when a level is fixed so the terminal's picker label matches (its echo also tells the model). The Desktop picker is app-owned and does not move.

rules.title: Routing rules
rules.description: Extra routing rules in plain words. Include a line that is exactly $defaults to keep the rules beneath (shipped defaults, then your organisation's); without it these rules replace them. A ~/.claude/effort-router.md file takes precedence over this option.

routeSubagents.title: Route subagents
routeSubagents.description: Give each subagent its own level from a read of its brief when it starts (searches and lookups low, implementing, debugging and review high); a fork, or a failed read, takes the parent's level. An agent whose own definition (a user or project agents file, or settings) sets an effort keeps it. Off: subagents run at the session's level. /route off also stops it.

footerControl.title: Footer control
footerControl.description: "button" (default): the footer state is a button that opens the router's band above the prompt. "label": plain text only; use /route to change the state.
